name: EmberSign
subtitle: On-device signing and tweak injection
description: Development releases of EmberSign for iOS.

apps.name: EmberSign
apps.subtitle: Apple Accounts, IPA signing and JIT tools
apps.localizedDescription: EmberSign signs IPAs using imported certificates or Apple Account provisioning, supports multiple saved Apple Accounts, compatible tweak injection, pairing-file management, JIT preparation, paired-device app inventory, best-effort app refresh, and error diagnostics with online lookup. Apple services and background refresh require device testing; a pairing tunnel is needed for installed-app inventory.

versions.localizedDescription: EmberSign 0.2.0 build 10: Apple Accounts, signing and provisioning, paired-device app inventory, quota estimates, refresh controls, JIT tools, and diagnostics.
First development release with certificate and provisioning-profile signing, compatible tweak injection, pairing-record import and export, and JIT preparation with StikDebug or SideJITServer handoff.
